column3: Primary action — safety-orange ground, ink fg, square
column4: padding: 12px 20px; background: var(--in-safety); color: var(--in-ink); border: 2px solid var(--in-ink); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--in-sans); font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
column5: ☐ AA contrast safety/ink ☐ thick border (2px) ☐ visible focus ring ☐ 44x44 touch min

column3: Secondary — hard border, ink on cream
column4: padding: 12px 20px; background: var(--in-cream); color: var(--in-ink); border: 2px solid var(--in-ink); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--in-sans); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ uppercase + tracking ☐ thick border ☐ hover ground swaps to safety

column3: Page ground — neutral cream-grey, never pure white
column4: background: var(--in-cream); color: var(--in-ink);
column5: ☐ ground not #fff ☐ AA contrast body ☐ workhorse undertone

column3: Display headline — sans condensed, bold, uppercase
column4: font-family: var(--in-sans-cond); font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.0; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--in-ink);
column5: ☐ uppercase applied ☐ condensed sans for density ☐ line-height tight ☐ AA contrast

column3: Caution stripe — diagonal safety-yellow pattern, decorative
column4: background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, var(--in-caution) 0 12px, var(--in-ink) 12px 24px); height: 6px;
column5: ☐ aria-hidden if decorative ☐ AA contrast pattern stripes ☐ NOT used as colour-only meaning

column3: Spec card — hard border, dense padding, mono spec rows
column4: padding: 16px; background: var(--in-cream); color: var(--in-ink); border: 2px solid var(--in-ink); border-radius: 2px;
column5: ☐ thick border (2px) ☐ no soft shadow ☐ no rounded corners ☐ AA contrast

column3: Spec row — label/value grid, mono value, hairline rule
column4: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 16px; padding-block: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--in-rule); font-family: var(--in-sans); font-size: 13px;
column5: ☐ semantic <dl>/<dt>/<dd> ☐ tabular-nums on value ☐ AA contrast

column3: Top nav — thick rule, safety-orange stripe accent
column4: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--in-cream); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--in-ink); position: relative;
column5: ☐ semantic <nav> ☐ thick rule (3px) ☐ skip-link ☐ aria-current

column3: Nav link — uppercase sans, hover-shifts-bg-to-safety
column4: color: var(--in-ink); font-family: var(--in-sans); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 8px 12px; transition: background-color 100ms;
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ hover ground shifts to safety ☐ visible focus ring

column3: Text input — thick black border, mono numerals, square
column4: padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--in-cream); color: var(--in-ink); font-family: var(--in-sans); font-size: 16px; border: 2px solid var(--in-ink); border-radius: 2px;
column5: ☐ font-size ≥16px iOS ☐ focus shifts border to safety ☐ tabular-nums on numeric type ☐ AA contrast

column3: Data table — dense rows, thick header rule, tabular-nums
column4: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--in-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 13px;
column5: ☐ tabular-nums ☐ thick header rule (2px) ☐ dense (no extra padding) ☐ AA contrast

column3: Table header — uppercase, ink ground
column4: padding: 8px 12px; text-align: left; background: var(--in-ink); color: var(--in-cream); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 11px;
column5: ☐ semantic <th scope='col'> ☐ AA contrast inverted ☐ uppercase

column3: Status badge — safety colour, square, uppercase
column4: display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--in-safety); color: var(--in-ink); border: 1px solid var(--in-ink); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--in-sans); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
column5: ☐ no rounded-pill ☐ AA contrast safety/ink ☐ semantic colour + text

column3: Warning icon — safety-yellow triangle, ink stroke
column4: width: 24px; height: 24px; color: var(--in-caution);
column5: ☐ stroke ≥2px for visibility ☐ aria-label when meaningful ☐ AA contrast

column3: Section divider — thick rule, no decoration
column4: height: 3px; background: var(--in-ink); margin-block: 48px; border-radius: 0;
column5: ☐ semantic <hr> ☐ thick (3px) ☐ no gradient

column3: Modal — hard-bordered, dense, no rounded corners
column4: padding: 24px; background: var(--in-cream); border: 3px solid var(--in-ink); border-radius: 2px; max-width: 520px;
column5: ☐ focus-trap ☐ ESC closes ☐ no soft shadow ☐ no rounded corners

column3: Utility list — dense rows, hairline rules
column4: display: flex; flex-direction: column;
column5: ☐ semantic <ul>/<li> ☐ hairline rules between ☐ dense padding (8px block)

column3: Focus ring — safety-orange outline, thick offset
column4: outline: 3px solid var(--in-safety); outline-offset: 2px;
column5: ☐ visible on all interactive ☐ thick (3px) ☐ AA contrast on cream ground

column3: Footer — ink ground, cream text
column4: padding-block: 40px 24px; background: var(--in-ink); color: var(--in-cream); font-family: var(--in-sans); font-size: 13px;
column5: ☐ semantic <footer> ☐ AA contrast inverted ☐ uppercase headings

column3: Spec caption — small mono, uppercase
column4: font-family: var(--in-sans); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--in-ink-muted);
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ uppercase + tracking ☐ adequate size (10px min)
